newsitem.title: GERMANY: TENNIS-GRAF WITHDRAWAL SETS UP HUBER-MAJOLI FINAL.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-GRAF WITHDRAWAL SETS UP HUBER-MAJOLI FINAL.

text.p: Steffi Graf withdrew from the $450,000 Leipzig women's tournament because of a knee injury on Saturday, giving her semifinal opponent Anke Huber a free passage into Sunday's final against Iva Majoli of Croatia.

Graf pulled out of the all-German duel only hours before it was due to get under way, leaving just Majoli's 7-5 6-4 victory over Helena Sukova of the Czech Republic for the disappointed 5,500 crowd to enjoy.

The world number one said a tendon strain in her left knee had troubled her in her quarter-final win over Judith Wiesner of Austria and she had to break off from a training session on Friday. She decided to pull out on Saturday morning.
"I'm really sorry I can't even try to play against Anke," Graf said in a statement. "It's the first time I've been unable to continue in a tournament because of injury."

Graf's withdrawal meant Huber, the defending champion, had been given a helping hand in the tournament for the second year in a row. She was awarded the title last year when fellow finalist Magdalena Maleeva withdrew beacuse of illness.
But Huber was unhappy at not having the chance to take on Graf. "I think it's a real shame as I'd really like to have played against Steffi," Huber said.
